review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. Narrative with dialogue. Ben says du to Lukas outside school (Lukas is Anna's brother and Ben's teacher; Ben is Marta's grandson). "Ich war noch nie im Kino" uses "war", which has been met since a1-1-15. "Regenschirm" and "Jacke" are the plain words for an umbrella and a jacket. "Mitkommen" is split in a main clause ("Kommst du mit?").

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Es ist Samstag, und es regnet.
sentences.english: It is Saturday, and it rains.

sentences.text: Es ist Wochenende, aber das Wetter ist schlecht.
sentences.english: It is the weekend, but the weather is bad.

sentences.text: Am Morgen essen sie Brötchen mit Butter und Ei.
sentences.english: In the morning they eat rolls with butter and egg.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Am Wochenende ist die Schule aus.
sentences.english: At the weekend school is out.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ja, aber was machen wir heute?
sentences.english: Yes, but what are we doing today?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich möchte nicht zu Hause bleiben.
sentences.english: I do not want to stay at home.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Mein Kopf tut weh, und mein Bauch auch.
sentences.english: My head hurts, and my stomach too.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: You do not need a tablet.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: Do not lie down in bed!

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Wir können einmal ins Kino gehen.
sentences.english: We could go to the cinema for once.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich war noch nie im Kino!
sentences.english: I have never been to the cinema!

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: Then let us go for once.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Nimm die Jacke und den Regenschirm.
sentences.english: Take the jacket and the umbrella.

sentences.text: Ben legt sein Heft in den Rucksack.
sentences.english: Ben puts his exercise book in his school bag.

sentences.text: Er sucht die Jacke und den Regenschirm.
sentences.english: He looks for the jacket and the umbrella.

sentences.text: Die Jacke liegt unter dem Bett.
sentences.english: The jacket is under the bed.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: It is next to the school bag.

sentences.text: Ben findet ihn, und er nimmt sie.
sentences.english: Ben finds it, and he takes it.

sentences.text: Er schreibt eine Nachricht an Anna.
sentences.english: He writes a message to Anna.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Ben und ich gehen heute ins Kino.
sentences.english: Ben and I are going to the cinema today.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Ich arbeite am Samstag und am Sonntag.
sentences.english: I work on Saturday and Sunday.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Ich habe am Montag einen Termin, aber ruf mich bald an!
sentences.english: I have an appointment on Monday, but call me soon!

sentences.text: Ben und Lukas sehen den Film.
sentences.english: Ben and Lukas watch the film.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: You do not have to cry, Ben.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich war noch nie so glücklich!
sentences.english: I have never been so happy!

sentences.text: Dann essen Ben und Lukas Pizza.
sentences.english: Then Ben and Lukas eat pizza.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: No, I do not have enough!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich möchte einmal eine große Pizza!
sentences.english: I would like a big pizza for once!
Anna would like to come along too.

sentences.text: Sam ist auch da, mit seinem neuen Handy.
sentences.english: Sam is there too, with his new phone.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Und es ist so lecker hier!
sentences.english: And it is so tasty here!

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Das Wetter ist schlecht, aber ihr seid froh.
sentences.english: The weather is bad, but you are happy.

sentences.text: Lukas liest das Wetter auf dem Handy.
sentences.english: Lukas reads the weather on his phone.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Am Montag regnet es, am Dienstag auch.
sentences.english: On Monday it rains, on Tuesday too.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Am Mittwoch gibt es Wind, und am Donnerstag scheint die Sonne.
sentences.english: On Wednesday there is wind, and on Thursday the sun shines.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich möchte bald wieder gehen, am Wochenende!
sentences.english: I would like to go again soon, at the weekend!

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Wir gehen jetzt zusammen nach Hause.
sentences.english: We are going home together now.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Die Straßenbahn fährt um acht Uhr ab.
sentences.english: The tram leaves at eight o'clock.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Dann gehen wir in die Kirche, mit Oma!
sentences.english: Then we go to church, with Grandma!

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Gut, wir bleiben nicht zu Hause.
sentences.english: Good, we are not staying at home.
